comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (57.14%) to r-Omiganan W=P: 23%, R: 38%. Activity: initial screen: inhibited E. coli O157:H7, K. pneumoniae ATCC700603, S. typhimurium ATCC14028, M. luteus ATCC4698, B. subtilis WB600, S. aureus ATCC6538, and C. albicans ATCC 10231 at 128 uM. MIC: Active against antibiotic-resistant livestock strain E. coli z44 (MIC 4 uM) and S. aureus 09057 (MIC 16 uM). Antioxidant.

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (41.18%) to Brochocin C, chain A A=G: 19%. GRAVY:0.251, mol wt: 6218.079, mol formula: C267H431N86O79S3, mol ex coeff: 7165. Activity: cell-free supernatant showed inhibitory effect on Gram+ bacteria L. monocytogenes ATCC 19115, S. aureus ATCC 25923, Gram- bacteria E. coli ATCC 25922, and P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853. More active against P. aeruginosa (80% inhibition). Antivirulence: showed a concentration-dependent suppression of pyocyanin, pyoverdine, elastase. Antibiofilms: killing bacteria in biofilms. MOA:bacteria: permeated bacterial membranes. Recombinant production:yeast:Pichia pastoris (formerly): Recombinant production:yeast:Komagataella phaffii: pPICZalpha-A expression vector, His-tag, under optimal expression conditions (21oC, pH 6.24, and 1.089% methanol), MIC50 143 ug/ml (23 uM); MIC90 320 ug/ml (51.4 uM) ( Akbari et al., 2025).
reference_text: Appl Environ Microbiol. 2020 May 5;86(10):e00367-20. doi: 10.1128/AEM.00367-20. PubMed
